subject: Request: Additional runtime S/W Engineer slots and comp bands
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Additional runtime S/W Engineer slots and comp bands

Team —

I’m requesting approval to open 3 additional Senior/Staff Software Engineer roles on the runtime team (infra/runtime/platform) to support the Q1 throughput and reliability roadmap. Quick summary: 

- Headcount: 3 FTEs (2 Senior SWE, 1 Staff SWE)
- Motivation: KV cache scaling work, continuous batching improvements, and kernel/quantization infra to reduce per-token cost for hosted customers
- Timeline: hiring kickoff mid-Nov, expected ramp (fully productive) by end of Q2 2027
- Expected FY27 incremental spend (comp + benefits): see attached spreadsheet

I've attached the headcount ask and a conservative comp projection. High-level asks for approvals: budget sign-off from Finance (Marissa), alignment on comp bands (Markus/Neha), and headcount authorization so Recruiting (cc: external) can start sourcing.

Attachments: runtime_hc_ask_nov2026.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) Markus/Neha — confirm banding and whether we should push two at Senior vs one at Staff.
2) Marissa — confirm charge codes and headcount budget availability.
3) Jonas/Vivek — operational approval to add slots to runtime org chart.

Thanks — I’ll be available all afternoon for a quick sync if helpful.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Additional runtime S/W Engineer slots and comp bands

Laura —

Thanks for the summary and the attachment. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
- Can you add an estimated 6–9 month ramp plan per role (rough bullets on milestones)? I want to see when we get throughput wins vs. where we need immediate infra coverage.
- Please populate the comp bands in the sheet in the "current offer" vs "target offer" columns. 

If bands look reasonable I’m supportive of 2 Senior + 1 Staff. If Neha flags market mismatch, we may need to allocate one of the slots as a Staff+ or move budget from an open SWE req in App Platform.

Markus
VP, Infrastructure

Markus — thanks. Updated the attachment and added a short ramp plan and proposed salary bands in the sheet. Summary here: 

- Senior SWE (2): target base range $180k–$210k, total comp on offer target $220k–$270k depending on level/stock
- Staff SWE (1): target base $230k–$260k, total comp on offer target $300k–$360k
- We recommend opening requisitions as Senior (2) and Staff (1) with flexibility to move one Senior to Staff+ if market demands.

Link to bands and offers sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/comp-bands-q4

Recruiting (Sarah) — please begin initial outreach using the attached JD and recruiter brief. We want an initial slate by Dec 10 so interviews can run in early Jan.

Attachment: job_band_projections.pdf

—Laura

Laura/Jonas —

Finance reviewed the spreadsheet. A few items we need before formal budget sign-off: 
1) Confirm the GL cost center/charge code you intend to use for these hires (we still have some committed dollars in 7421-runtime-eng).
2) Are any of these roles expected to be filled as contractors for the first 3 months? If so, we need to model blended comp.
3) If we proceed with the higher target band for Staff, we need justification memo for reallocation of headroom from Q2 hiring plan (link HR-REQ: HR-REQ-4521).

Once the three items above are in, Marissa can issue formal sign-off (will take ~2 business days).

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on the updated bands and the finance clarifications requested, I approve moving forward with opening the 3 reqs. Laura — please:
- Confirm the GL charge code (reply directly to Marissa)

- Ask Recruiting to start outreach targeting first slates by Dec 10

Markus/Neha — please let Recruiting know if you want any changes to the JD prior to outreach.

Jonas
